Definition: middle voice from πέρπερος (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the base of G4008); to boast:--vaunt itself.
BiblicalUsage: Perpereuomai means to vaunt oneself, to brag. Paul says love does not brag, it does not puff itself up, and he puts the braggart's spirit on the far side of love.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love has no use for showing off: the moment I start vaunting myself, I have stopped loving and started performing.
